SELECT o.order_id, o.record_id, o.pet_id, o.client_id, o.doctor_id, o.order_note, o.fee, o.status, o.result_note, o.result_by, o.report_file, o.create_time, o.specimen_type, o.collect_time, o.receive_time, o.review_by, o.review_at, o.critical_flag, o.result_revision, o.critical_handled, o.critical_handle_by, o.critical_handle_at, o.critical_notify_at, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name, m.diagnosis FROM lab_order o LEFT JOIN pet p ON o.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON o.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON o.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN medical_record m ON o.record_id = m.record_id WHERE o.is_del = 0 AND o.is_cancel = 0
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.create_time ASC
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
